title: KYLIN O’BRIEN | ART UNDER THE BRIDGE

raw.note: source text and images: never publication copy, never published
raw.description:
Kylin O’Brien | Art Under the Bridge

Exhibition | October 29 – December 3, 2026

Opening Reception: October 29, 6–9 PM

BACI STUDIO presents Kylin O’Brien, Art Under the Bridge, a retrospective exhibition of paintings and interactive mixed media works.

During the exhibition, the artist will be launching her new book, Kylin O’Brien, Art Under the Bridge: 18 Years of Creativity in Community.

Art Under the Bridge features several paintings which are emblematic of O’Brien’s larger practice of creating work that is explicitly and mindfully imbued with metaphysical intention. The selection of paintings in this exhibition will span over a decade of work, and are among the last fine art objects she intends to create.

Best known for interactive public works, alongside these paintings O’Brien will be exhibiting The Giant Get Well Card for Humanity, that visitors can sign, and complimentary "prescriptions” from the artist’s Placebo Pharmacy.

The opening reception will feature interactive art experiences and an opportunity to meet the artist.

Special Event – November 12, 7–9 PM

Local Legends: A Night of Creative Legacy brings together artists and cultural figures who helped shape DUMBO for an evening of conversation, music, and community.

Join us at Baci Studio as we celebrate the artists who shaped DUMBO's past and continue to inspire its future.

title: Ben Zo, DrToof, Henry Jennings, Scallywag

raw.note: source text and images: never publication copy, never published
raw.description:
BUSH DÜF throws a fist-pumping finale to Halloweekend at our favorite little spot along the L.

Ben Zo opens our evening with his measured mixing of mesmerizing selections. The decisive DÜF director often harmonizes unexpected influences like acid, Italo and progressive sounds into ambitious set construction rooted in any mandate.

DrToof then returns to our party in his long-overdue Jupiter Disco debut. The doctor-by-day and multi-genre mixer-by-night takes the reins once the sky darkens for a potent sonic procedure as surgical as it is expressive.

Henry Jennings pilots our spaceship thereafter as a consummate commander of kinetic and otherworldly grooves. With a cinematic sensibility for psychedelic techno both hypnotic and exuberant, expect not only high-caliber productions of his own making, but wide-reaching wormholes carved from awe-inducing waveforms.

Afterward, Scallywag seizes our attention as a prescient mixer of propulsive selections. A co-organizer of annual party Fourth World and long-running Lost Soul Enterprises, he is a tastemaker's tastemaker who leads us to midnight and beyond with a range that scouts leftfield levity, industrial introspection and bodily ecstasy within the core mantle of four-on-the-floor.

To conclude, Young link lands us safely with her arresting attunement to renegade rhythms spanning techno, electro, breaks and other big-brained bangers.

Honey Trap Roller Discoteque ft. Amelia Holt, bouffant bouffant | Club Flush: Second Contact b2b Conduit (skate)

Honey Trap’s first roller disco night at Xanadu🛼 is finally happening on SUNDAY, November 8th at 8 PM

We are joined by New Orlean’s most dangerous gay Bouffant Bouffant and the Honey Trap residents Amelia Holt, Second Contact and Conduit.

Come for a little sweat and dance ;)

Mark your calendars!

A love letter to Sunday Skate Club 🫶

Every Sunday from 8–12am, the rink becomes more than a skate session. It’s a weekly ritual where local club kids, industry folks, and NYC’s DJs get their flowers — and skate heads and music heads move in the same orbit.

Here you see the true versatility of a DJ. That epic artist you loved at 5am now accepts the challenge of an all-skate set around a groovy 100bpm — R&B, disco, and other unexpected jams. It’s a rare chance to hear their non-unz unz selections like R&B, disco, you name it. From thudding foggy sweaty beats the morning before (well, it may have still been your ‘night’) to idyllic skating in a psychedelic rink with jams that make you smile big. You start with a few laps, feeling out the floor, the room fills, the rhythm builds, and before long, you’re moving without thinking — just you, the music, and the night.

Then you notice friends slipping into the bathrooms… only it’s Club Flush, pulling the off-wheels crowd into something sweatier, louder, a little unhinged. Red-lit and hazy, fog stretching the room so it feels bigger than it is. An 18” sub shakes the floor, a hidden 21” built straight into the booth hits your chest. There are no grimy stalls, no smells (thanks all!) just a fully enclosed, immersive room. A few minutes in, and you forget you’re even standing in a bathroom. You might walk in for a second and stay for half a set. You might discover your new favorite DJ. You might skate, then dance, then skate again. That’s the point.

Every week is a different crew, a different sound, a different pocket of the city’s underground stepping forward. Sunday Skate Club is about unified movement — wheels, feet, bass, community. When these scenes overlap, the energy multiplies, and the night becomes something bigger than the sum of its parts.

See you every Sunday at 8.

Vibe and skate to the music of 70s/80s Disco, Funk, R&B, and 90s/2000s Hip Hop

Booth reservations are available for parties 7+ via form: https://www.xanadu.nyc/booking

General Admission tickets are included in all booth reservations.

🚨Important Info🚨

· Ticket does \*NOT\* include Skate Rental.

· Skates & safety gear are available to rent \*\*first come, first served\*\*

· All sales are final. No refunds.

· You must sign the Xanadu waiver in advance here: https://shorturl.at/AJbHn

· Valid Government ID required for entry. Photos of IDs are not accepted

· Gum, outside food and drink is not allowed.

· All bags are subject to search at the venue entrance.

· Xanadu is wheelchair accessible and includes entry ramps and ADA bathrooms. Write to info@xanadu.nyc if you require extra assistance.

· Xanadu is an inclusive, safe space. We do not tolerate harassment, aggression, racism, bigotry, or hatred of any kind.

Skating is FUN. Skating is RISKY!

Together we will create a skate experience that is fun and safe for everyone on the rink!

· Be mindful of yourself, your limits and others around you.

· Our Skate Guards are always here to help! Please alert them to any hazards or unsafe behavior on the rink so that they can help.

· Rink capacity fluctuates throughout each session- if you are ever feeling overwhelmed, take a quick break and get back into the flow when you’re ready.

· Keep each other safe & happy! Less friction, more FLOW.

More questions? Find answers here: xanadu.nyc/FAQ

**Let’s meet at Seventh Heaven!** While walk-ins are always accepted, we love to know that you’re coming! We offer a no-fee, complimentary rsvp for our communal karaoke nights. Get ready to make new friends!

- Designed by karaoke lovers and professional sound engineers, Seventh Heaven boasts a club-quality sound system, multiple big screen TVs (plus a few vintage ones), and up to two microphones so you can sing solo or a duet. We have songs available in over 20 languages!
- In between songs? Our main bar room and outdoor space are ideal for conversation. Our menu features a curated selection of signature cocktails, sommelier-selected wines and unique Japanese drafts. Enjoy our selection of rare books and games. We have board games, a selection of rare books, and even a free-to-play arcade machine!
- With one of the largest karaoke rooms in New York City, Seventh Heaven can accommodate reservations of all sizes. Invite your closest friends or everyone you’ve ever met!
- If you would like to reserve Seventh Heaven for 50+ guests or would like to book a fully private event, please email our booking team at reservations@seventhheaven.bar and we’ll get back to you regarding availability and pricing.
